steps.en: Run it inside your repo and sign in with your ChatGPT account
steps.zh: 在仓库目录里运行，用 ChatGPT 账号登录

steps.en: Describe the change you want in the terminal UI
steps.zh: 在终端界面里说清楚要改什么

steps.en: Reads the relevant files and plans edits and commands with the model
steps.zh: 读相关文件，和模型一起规划要改的代码和要跑的命令

steps.en: Edits and runs tests inside the OS sandbox, asking before leaving its bounds
steps.zh: 在操作系统沙箱里改代码、跑测试，越界前先问你

steps.en: Review the diff it shows and keep or redirect the work
steps.zh: 审它给出的 diff，留下或让它改方向

value.en: The edit-run-fix loop happens on your machine without you copy-pasting between chat and terminal
value.zh: 改代码、跑测试、再修的循环直接在你机器上完成，不用在聊天窗口和终端之间来回粘贴

sources: https://github.com/openai/codex#quickstart (npm install -g @openai/codex, brew install --cask codex, run codex, Sign in with ChatGPT)
https://developers.openai.com/codex/concepts/sandboxing (default permissions mode sandboxes commands; Seatbelt on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux)
https://developers.openai.com/codex/agent-approvals-security (Auto preset edits and runs in the workspace, asks for approval outside it)
